changelog: - **The marketing vertical wears SaleVali's own colours and mark** (#2492, epic #2348). A new `magenta` accent joins the picker for everyone and is the MARKETING vertical's default (`defaultAccentFor` / `resolveAccent(preference, vertical)` in `src/lib/accent.ts`): the scale is anchored on salevali.de's own palette (50/100 = brand tints, 500 = brand primary `#cc33e5` for fills, 700 = brand dark `#9b1dbd`) with 600 = `#b929cf`, chosen so white text on primary buttons is 4.9:1 and link text 4.7:1 on the page body — the brand primary itself is 4.1:1 and would have regressed WCAG AA. The graduation cap gives way to the SaleVali "V" (`SaleValiMark`, cropped from the brand SVG with its gradients intact and collision-safe ids) through one `BrandMark`/`BrandTile` pair used by the header, footer, sidebar wordmark, release-notes link and the five auth pages, where the mark sits on the brand's deep-purple tile (10.9:1) rather than on magenta, where its orange tail vanishes. The favicon, Apple touch icon, browser tint (`generateViewport`) and the web-app manifest (name, icons, `theme_color`) follow the host too — `app/icon.svg` moved to `public/` so the `<link rel="icon">` can branch, and the manifest reads the host because a manifest fetch carries no cookies. INTERNSHIP is unchanged: blue accent, cap, the same manifest and icons. The profile validator (`PUT /api/profile`) now reads the colour list from `ACCENT_COLORS` instead of carrying its own six-entry copy — the copy rejected Magenta with a 400 while the picker offered it, and `e2e/accent-color.spec.ts` now picks the newest colour so the next addition trips the same test. Review follow-ups: the marketing `<link rel="icon">` list carries a PNG fallback (Safari loads no SVG favicon and fell through to the implicit `/favicon.ico`, the cap); `/messages` gets its own `generateViewport()` reading the shared `themeColorFor(vertical)` (its static `#1D4ED8` painted a SaleVali install's status bar blue on the very screen its manifest shortcut opens — the manifest reads the same helper); and `scripts/generate-pwa-images.ts` — which still read `src/app/icon.svg` and crashed — now renders every raster (manifest icons, a *full-bleed* maskable icon, apple-touch icon, shortcut tiles, iOS splash screens) for **both** marks from `public/icon.svg` / `public/icon-salevali.svg`, so the marketing manifest's shortcuts sit on the purple tile and `appleSplashLinks('salevali')` has images to point at. The internship rasters are regenerated by the same code path; the one visible change there is `apple-touch-icon.png`, now full-bleed (iOS painted its transparent corners black).

en: The marketing product now looks like SaleVali — its magenta accent, its V mark and its own app icon — and Magenta is a new accent anyone can pick in Account.
tr: Pazarlama ürünü artık SaleVali gibi görünüyor — macenta vurgu rengi, V işareti ve kendi uygulama simgesi; Macenta ayrıca Hesap'ta herkesin seçebileceği yeni bir vurgu rengi.
de: Das Marketing-Produkt sieht jetzt aus wie SaleVali — Magenta-Akzent, das V-Zeichen und ein eigenes App-Symbol; Magenta ist außerdem eine neue Akzentfarbe, die jeder im Konto wählen kann.
